# Parley v0.1.51

Three worktree changes from the first hour with the v0.1.50 board.

## Tracked trees can be removed

The board listed five worktrees that were fully integrated (ahead 0, HEAD
contained in main, clean) and refused to remove any of them, because an
older Parley had created them and this one had no creation marker to
compare. The rule was "Parley-created trees only". The facts that keep a
removal safe never depended on that marker: nested worktrees, any pane
inside, modified or untracked files, commits not contained in main, locks,
Git's own refusal without `--force`. Every one of those applies to a
tracked tree exactly as before.

So **Remove…** is now offered on every recorded tree. For a tree Parley did
not create, the preview says that there is no creation marker to compare and
that its identity for this removal is Git's registry entry at the recorded
path, checked just now. Every other refusal is unchanged, the removal is
still one `git worktree remove` without `--force`, and the branch is kept. A
Parley-created tree whose marker is gone is still refused, because someone
else may own what sits at that path now.

## Board tidy-ups

- **Integrate…** is no longer offered on a tree that already reads
  INTEGRATED. There is nothing to merge; Git would only have said so.
- The redundant small "person-owned" text beside the buttons is gone. The
  owner label after the state chip already says it.

## Compatibility

Agent protocol unchanged at 32. No pane needs a restart. No record format
changed.

Validated: 354 native checks (one new real-Git check: a clean tracked tree
is removed with its branch kept, a dirty one and a pane inside are refused,
a Parley-created tree without its marker stays refused), 53 Node tests,
public scan, platform scan and build.

Unnotarized test beta: ad-hoc signed without the hardened runtime, not
notarized, no automatic updates. Install only from the expected GitLab
release after checking SHA256SUMS.
